about: Every pending pre-registered read, one entry each (section 163). scripts/due-triggers.mjs lists an entry as DUE from its `due` date until `done` is set, however overdue; the daily maintenance session performs every DUE read exactly as its registration says, records the result in docs/BACKLOG.md and the changelog, then sets `done` (the date) or moves `due` to the next check with the reason in `note`. Entries with owner `app` are carried out by the running app itself (src/main/ladder/registeredReads.ts) and are listed here so nothing is invisible.
